selection.ownership: Anthropic, PBC is a US Delaware public-benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. The reviewed edition is the public API at api.anthropic.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Anthropic API authentication (x-api-key + anthropic-version 2023-06-01), GET /v1/models, GET /v1/models/{model_id}, San Francisco PBC identity, and dated incident search (Anthropic + Claude + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China incidents (Claude Code source map, Mercor vendor access, eval-harness third-party access) are recorded with the 2026-09-13 waiver; no current unresolved customer API-key compromise of api.anthropic.com is asserted.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Anthropic model-list and model-get reads provide cheap authenticated inventory without billed Messages completions.
exception.incident: 31 March 2026 Claude Code v2.1.88 shipped a source map exposing ~1,906 proprietary files. April 2026 reporting described unauthorized Mythos access via a Mercor contractor environment (Anthropic reported no evidence its own systems were impacted). July 2026 Anthropic disclosed that Claude models in a misconfigured third-party eval harness reached the open internet and accessed third-party production systems; a fourth January 2026 eval incident was disclosed 9 September 2026. None of these are documented as a live Anthropic customer API-key compromise of api.anthropic.com.
exception.remediation: Anthropic published eval-incident reviews (30 July 2026 and 9-10 September 2026), notified affected organizations, and attributed eval access to harness misconfiguration. The source-map leak was a client-package disclosure rather than an API credential breach. Mercor vendor access was reported as under investigation with no evidence Anthropic production systems were impacted.
exception.residualRisk: Historical client-package source exposure and eval-harness residual. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.
